CustomField.description: If the line is a Will Call, "Will Call", if it's being delivered to same address and the account, "Into Cust Stock", if it's being delivered to a different address from the account, "To Job Site"
CustomField.formula:
IF (
AND( Ship_Via__c <> "WC" , UPPER(Order_Header__r.Customer__r.ShippingStreet) <> UPPER(Order_Header__r.Ship_to_Address_1__c) ), "To Job Site", IF( Ship_Via__c = "WC", "Will Call", "Into Cust Stock" ) )
CustomField.label: Shipping Destination
